policy: Require evidence of instruction, not merely a matching title or a raw play/drill cutup. Accept exact named teaching chapters (including an instructional opening chapter at zero), timed transcripts, or an entire exclusive-topic short under 120 seconds whose publisher description establishes teaching. No fabricated offsets or category fallback.
method: Re-reviewed all 40 decisions using public publisher descriptions, YouTube chapter cards and companion coach pages. Existing clips received fresh watch-page metadata checks; replacement metadata uses the embedded-player preview with the site origin. Bulk watch-page requests were stopped after HTTP 429. Embed preview OK is recorded separately from actual browser playback, which this content review did not test. No timed transcript was successfully retrieved.
